title: Smart Devices and Privacy
text:
Smart devices such as phones, speakers and watches collect information about their users every day. Many companies use this data to improve their products and to show personalised adverts. Some people feel uncomfortable because they do not know exactly what information is being shared. Security experts recommend checking privacy settings regularly.

Governments also use surveillance cameras and digital records to fight crime. Supporters say these tools make cities safer, while critics worry that they reduce personal freedom. Most people agree that a balance between safety and privacy is necessary.

questions.text: According to the passage, what do many companies use the collected data for?
options: To improve products and show personalised adverts
To sell smart devices at lower prices

questions.text: What do supporters say about surveillance cameras?
options: They are too expensive to install
They are used only in shops
They have no effect on crime

questions.text: Why do some people feel uncomfortable with smart devices?
options: They are unsure what information is being shared
They cannot afford to buy them
They think the devices are too slow
They dislike the design of the screens

questions.text: What is the writer's overall view of the balance between safety and privacy?
options: It is a difficult issue that needs careful balance
It can be solved by removing all cameras
It is not important to most people
It should be decided only by companies

vocabulary.definition: the state of keeping personal information secret
the close watching of people, often by cameras or official bodies
designed to suit one particular person

paragraph_translations: Telefonlar, hoparlörler ve saatler gibi akıllı cihazlar kullanıcıları hakkında her gün bilgi toplar. Birçok şirket bu verileri ürünlerini geliştirmek ve kişiselleştirilmiş reklamlar göstermek için kullanır. Bazı insanlar hangi bilgilerin tam olarak paylaşıldığını bilmedikleri için rahatsız hisseder. Güvenlik uzmanları gizlilik ayarlarını düzenli olarak kontrol etmeyi önerir.

Hükümetler de suçla mücadele etmek için gözetim kameralarını ve dijital kayıtları kullanır. Destekçiler bu araçların şehirleri daha güvenli hale getirdiğini söyler, eleştirmenler ise bunların kişisel özgürlüğü azalttığından endişe eder. Çoğu insan güvenlik ile gizlilik arasında bir dengenin gerekli olduğunda hemfikirdir.
